properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - As of March 1, 2023, all food establishments must have a Certified Food Protection Manager. They need a certificate in food safety management from an accredited program. They take and active approach to train staff and prevent foodborne illness . The facility can contract out a food protection manager or have a family member take the training, as long as the certified protection manager is available to answer their questions. The food protection manager does not have to be onsite but a copy of their certificate needs to be available for review during their inspections. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 07/18/2026 2600 Compliance with valid permit; operating and risk control plans and required written procedures. 2600 Observed mobile not operating as approved. Observed the following: • Mobile was not hooked up to power when inspector first arrived. • Due to no power the hand wash station was at 66F. • Mobile had salsas and sour cream cold holding on ice on a table and cooler off the mobile . The mobile must operate as approved . Mobile unit operating conditions include: • Mobile must be hooked up to power the entire time the mobile is operating and/or transporting food. • Hand wash station must be functional and providing hot water between 100-120F. • All equipment and food must be stored on the mobile . • All TCS food must be stored in mechanical refrigeration or hot holding equipment . You need plan review approval before you change your operating procedures . You can find a plan review application at www.tpchd.org/healthy-places/food-safety/opening-a-food-business. Call (253) 649-1706 if you need assistance. While on site mobile was able to restore power, bring hot water to 100F, and move salsa's into the refrigerator. To operate as approved you must : • Have power provided to the mobile the entire time you are driving and operating. • Keep all equipment and food on the mobile. • All TCS food must be stored in mechanical refrigeration or hot holding equipment . *A compliance order has been issued to operate as approved immediately . Failure to meet the approval conditions listed above by 7/18/26 will result in a fee of $240 for non-compliance. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
